title: Add a computer
name: Name
name_note: Shown in the app and on the web. Any language works.
linux_step_install: On that computer, open a terminal, paste this line and press Enter. It installs Persona's background service and connects.
linux_step_pair: This hub doesn't know where its install script is. Install jarvis-link on that computer first, then paste this line in a terminal and press Enter.
linux_step_done: Once it says it's paired, this screen moves on by itself.
windows_step_get: On that computer, put Persona's two programs (the two .exe files in the line below) in one folder. There's no installer yet, so you build them yourself; the tray app is still in the works.
windows_step_run: Open PowerShell in that folder, paste this line and press Return.
windows_note: It installs as a background task that starts when you sign in. No window, no admin rights.
mac_step_install: Install Persona Link on that Mac. There's no installer yet, so you build it from source.
mac_step_link: Send the pairing link to that Mac, click the Persona Link icon in the menu bar › Pair…, and paste it.
expired: This link has expired and the computer hasn't connected.
joined: A computer wants to join: {name}. Is it yours?
joined_hint: Only once you confirm does Persona work on it and give it your model keys. If you don't know it, reject it and it's removed.
confirmed_hint: It's in the machine list now, and you can pick it for new agents.
rejected_hint: The pairing link it used no longer works. Add the computer again to try once more.
